# C# Development Rules

- Always include all required `using` directives.
- Do not rely on implicit or global usings unless they already exist in the project.
- Always respect existing method signatures.
- Never invent method parameters or APIs.
- Follow the existing project architecture and naming conventions.
- Prefer existing abstractions over creating new ones.
- Do not modify unrelated files.
- Use async/await consistently for asynchronous operations.
- Follow the existing Architecture patterns.
